# Passim AI for Antigravity

Connect Google Antigravity to the **Passim AI** (formerly BIA Edge) remote MCP server for U.S. immigration law research — the same read-only MCP endpoint served to Claude and ChatGPT.

## What's included

This plugin configures the Passim AI remote Streamable HTTP MCP server (`https://mcp.biaedge.com/mcp`), providing read-only retrieval tools across:

- Published BIA, Attorney General, OCAHO, Supreme Court, federal circuit, and federal district immigration decisions
- Unpublished BIA and AAO non-precedent decisions
- Case validity and citation treatment checks (ImmCite)
- INA and Title 8 / related CFR statutes and regulations
- USCIS Policy Manual, Foreign Affairs Manual (FAM), and agency guidance
- State and federal criminal codes for crimmigration screening
- Visa Bulletin priority dates and EOIR immigration court statistics

Passim AI is a corpus-and-retrieval layer designed for the agent to verify source text and synthesize work product; it is not legal advice and performs no write, send, or delete actions.

## Installation

Install directly from this repository in the Antigravity CLI:

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/passim-ai/passim-antigravity-plugin
```

Or add the plugin via **Customizations → Marketplace** once listed.

## Prerequisites & Authentication

- A Passim AI account ([passimai.com](https://passimai.com))
- Authentication uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration (WorkOS AuthKit). Antigravity will prompt you to sign in automatically when the MCP server connects.

## Example Prompts

- *Check whether Matter of A-R-C-G- is still good law and summarize its treatment history*
- *Search unpublished BIA and AAO decisions on extreme hardship waivers*
- *Look up the current INA, CFR, and USCIS Policy Manual rules for unlawful presence waivers*

## Support & Links

- Website: https://passimai.com
- Support: chris@passimai.com
